long_biography.plain_text:
Committing JD.com to its own logistics network was Liu Qiangdong's defining strategic decision. The investment gave the company direct control over warehousing, fulfilment and the condition in which orders reached customers, distinguishing its model from marketplace-only rivals.

A melted ice cream delivery revealed how closely Liu monitored that promise. He halted the expansion of grocery delivery until the service failure was fixed, treating an ordinary order as a test of the wider system. The episode captured the operating discipline behind a network built to join product quality, customer service and supply-chain technology.
